messages:
Sasha Ivanov: hey everyone — excited to join Redwood Inference! starting today as a runtime engineer on eng-runtime. quick q: where do i pick up laptop/stickers, and who do i ping for gcloud creds? also fun fact: i bake sourdough :bread:

Amelia Park: welcome Sasha :tada: — so glad to have you. For hardware, ping Devon or fill out the hardware form: https://intranet.redwood.com/onboard/hardware. For cloud creds, Devon will start the access request. i'll add you to #eng-runtime and set up our 1:1. also bring sourdough to demo day? :eyes: 

Devon Chen: hey Sasha — welcome! On badge/laptop: stop by People Ops desk on floor 3 between 10:00–16:00 or submit this form: https://go/redwood/hardware-request. i created ticket #34812 for you. for cloud access i need your work email + manager approval — can you DM me Amelia's confirm?

Mike Rivera: hey hi hi! i'm your onboarding buddy — happy to do a quick sync. 30m coffee? calendar: https://cal.com/mike/30. sticker situation: kitchen sticker jar, help yourself :stuck_out_tongue: 

Sasha Ivanov: thanks all! dm'd Devon with my email. i'll swing by after standup. Mike — coffee pls. i'll bring a tiny sourdough loaf to share.

OnboardingBot: Welcome Sasha Ivanov! You've been added to: #eng-runtime, #dev-tools, #new-hires. Onboarding checklist created: https://intranet.redwood.com/onboard/checklist/1788456789. Run the verify script on the jumpbox to confirm access:
```
ssh sasha@jumpbox.redwood
/opt/redwood/bin/onboard-verify --check
```

Amelia Park: tiny reminder — join #lunch-plans to find folks for Friday lunch. see you at standup 10:15 :wave:
